premise: After being abandoned at the altar by her fiancé for her sister, a noblewoman marries a mysterious scarred warrior and chooses exile over her family's cruelty, unaware he is a duke reclaiming his stolen title.

characters.name: Lady Juliana
characters.role: Protagonist; noblewoman and herbalist who marries a mysterious warrior after being abandoned at the altar.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.role: Duke of Ashburn; scarred war veteran who marries Juliana and secretly works to reclaim his usurped title.

characters.name: Gerald
characters.role: Juliana's former fiancé; abandons her at the altar for her sister and later conspires against her.

characters.name: Clarissa
characters.role: Juliana's cruel sister; marries Gerald and participates in schemes against Juliana.

characters.name: Rupert
characters.role: Usurper; conspires with Catherine to poison the Dowager Duchess and seize the dukedom.

characters.name: Catherine
characters.role: Co-conspirator; Rupert's partner who later becomes Catherine Ashbridge and plots against Juliana and Alexander.

characters.name: Dowager Duchess
characters.role: Alexander's mother; poisoned by Rupert and Catherine, later rescued.

characters.name: Lady Ashcroft
characters.role: Juliana's stepmother; disowns Juliana and sides with Gerald and Clarissa.

characters.name: Prudence
characters.role: Villager; Juliana's loyal ally who helps her infiltrate Ashbury Manor.

characters.name: Father Thomas
characters.role: Corrupt priest; allies with Catherine to undermine Alexander and Juliana.

characters.name: Lord Sterling
characters.role: Aristocratic conspirator; supports Rupert and Catherine's coup.

characters.name: High Priest
characters.role: Ecclesiastical authority; invalidates Alexander and Juliana's marriage.
